# VoxTranslate

> Free real-time AI voice translator for video calls: translate your voice live, voice-to-voice, with live captions and auto-translated chat across 84 languages, right in your browser.

VoxTranslate is a browser-based app for real-time translated video calls and meetings. Speak your own language and be understood in everyone else's: live speech-to-text captions, spoken voice-to-voice translation, and auto-translated text chat. No install, free to start.

## App
- [Launch VoxTranslate](https://voxtranslate.app/): start or join a real-time translated video call.

## Product & blog
- [Product site](https://website.voxtranslate.app/en/): features, four quality tiers, pricing, and the blog.
- [VoxTranslate for Business](https://website.voxtranslate.app/en/business/): translated meetings for teams — shared history, transcripts, projects, and compliance.
- [Guides & comparisons (blog)](https://website.voxtranslate.app/en/blog/): including how AI voice translation compares to Google Translate.
- [Machine-readable site map for LLMs](https://website.voxtranslate.app/llms.txt): the marketing site's own llms.txt with the full article list.
